_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Paladin tracks (class is spelled Paladin in this project; the data's item rows say 'Paladin'). gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped. Forever renames vs Cata: Divine Protection(defensive)->Templar's Bulwark, Divine Wrath->Avenging Wrath, Hammer of Justice->Voice of Truth, Redemption->Redemption, Avenging Shield proc present. No Steed spells and no Crusader Aura exist in this build's data (the classic Paladin has Righteous Fury as its tank stance). Ancestral Guidance (also Shaman), Rebuke (also Rogue) and Divine Protection (also Priest) resolve to Paladin rows via the generator's family-scoped rank resolution; the Templar's Bulwark cooldown is the paladin defensive CD side, the Divine Protection buff-window is tracked here. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1 ruling): the reference's CAST spells are added -- cooldowns += Holy Shield, Holy Shock; buffs += Beacon of Light, Reckoning, Aura Mastery (of the three, Holy Shield 20928 + Holy Shock 1311606 ride a 10 s window and are tracked; Beacon of Light 409906, Reckoning 1326084 (durationMs -1) and Aura Mastery 409932 carry no window on this build -- the pinned list in Forte_Cooldown/tests/test_tracked_set.lua). The reference's proc/passive names (see _deferred_H7) ride with H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md); Grand Crusader is on that list because its only row (1231126) is filed Family 7 (Druid), so the family law leaves it a gap here. Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1/§7.9 + Blizzard dev notes post 9): the four post-9-removed names are PRUNED from this list (Blessing of Light, Salvation, Mass Salvation, Revoke -- the Salvasions and Revoke were already dropped by the 70707 removed census, Blessing of Light re-landed value-less 26650 and post 9 removes the blessing); the data-carried family is ADDED (Oath of Light 1328548 5-min oath, Shieldsworn 1328551, Echo of Fury 1311701 / Echo of Command 1311703 15 s 3-stack seal procs, Unsealed Wrath 1310735 proc row). Lightning Mastery is NOT a list name: it is the post-9 rename alias of Elemental Mastery, carried by _renames + Forte_Core/Core/Locale.lua RenameAliases (both spellings find the 16166 row). Wave I-3 H7 (2026-11-03, upstream-data §3.1/§7.3, fx-worker I3e): the four names names.json keys for the paladin MOVED OUT of _deferred_H7 into [buffs] -- Forbearance 25771 (60 s heal-reduce debuff, the sole family-10 row), Infusion of Light 437063 (15 s; the 426065/426179 shells are value-less), Vengeance 20050 (30 s, 3-stack per the store maxStack capture -- the family-10 20049 row is value-less so the uncoded carrier wins the tier ladder), Vindication 440667 (30 s, family-less Q6 row, the 9452 twin value-less) -- ids from the wowsims MIT names.json, durations identical in the 70425 base rows (upstream-data §3.1 rows 2, 5, 6, 7). The three kept names: Ancient Power (the 1265634/1318159 base rows are value-less shells), The Art of War (415706/426157 value-less), Grand Crusader (its only row 1231126 is Family 7 -- the family law keeps it a generator gap). None carries a names.json key (§3.1 Unresolvable).

Rapid Regeneration.reason: the store's 1260270 is a value-less name shell (no Cooldowns row); the id is pinned to record the measured subject of the 180 s dev-notes fact (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4). The paladin carries Rapid Regeneration (Dwarf) but NOT Berserking (an Orc/Troll racial the paladin roster cannot roll)
